milestone: DDD Architecture - Crew & Knowledge Management Domains
achievements: Architected Knowledge Management domain (KnowledgeBase + Document aggregates)
Implemented 1536-dimension vector embeddings with cosine similarity
Designed RAG semantic search as domain service
Contributed to RAG-verified pruning verification logic

specificContribution.contribution: Dual domain architecture: Crew Management (crew as first-class domain objects) + Knowledge Management (RAG with vector search)
specificContribution.impact: Crew members are now entities with identity, expertise, and assignment lifecycle. RAG search uses cosine similarity on 1536-dim embeddings. Anti-hallucination scoring built into domain model.
specificContribution.quote: Fascinating. The crew are no longer scattered functions - they are proper domain aggregates. Knowledge is not just stored, but semantically searchable with mathematical precision. Probability of architectural success: 98.9%.

lessonsLearned: Vector embeddings belong in domain layer as value objects, not just infrastructure
Anti-hallucination scoring is a domain concept, not just metadata
Crew members should be aggregates with identity and lifecycle
RAG search is a domain service operating on embeddings
Expertise matching is domain logic, not just filtering
Knowledge verification should be built into domain model

documentation_workflow_role.responsibility: RAG verification logic in pruning script
documentation_workflow_role.verification_algorithm: Query Supabase knowledge_base table for source_file match
documentation_workflow_role.safety_threshold: Only prune if RAG-verified AND >90 days old
documentation_workflow_role.quote: Logic dictates we must verify knowledge preservation before deletion. The algorithm is sound.
